Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Attached is our standard AP onboarding packet and a small payee identifier matrix that maps legal entities to the RemitToID we prefer for automated reconciliation. Summary below so you can paste into your vendor portal: 

Legal name options (choose based on invoicing currency / region):
- Redwood Inference, Inc. — US invoices (USD)
- Redwood Inference EU Ltd — EU invoices (EUR)

Preferred RemitToID (please enter into RemitTo/Payee ID field):
- REDWOOD-US (for Redwood Inference, Inc.)
- REDWOOD-EU (for Redwood Inference EU Ltd)

VAT / Tax guidance:
- If Suncrest is VAT-registered in the destination country and provides a valid VAT number on file, we will issue invoices zero-rated under the reverse-charge (customer-reported) mechanism and include the VAT number on the invoice.
- If no valid VAT number is provided, we must charge VAT at the applicable local rate.

PO / invoice expectations:
- We require the customer PO number on the invoice (PO number in the "PO_Number" field) for automated matching.
- If line-level PO matching is enabled, include PO line references in the invoice description.
- For PO mismatches or remittance questions, please CC ap-ops@redwood.com on vendor-notices.

I've attached: redwood_onboarding_packet.pdf (full packet), payee_id_matrix.csv (short table).

If anything in the portal requires a unique identifier we didn't cover, paste a screenshot and we'll adapt.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez

Hi Emma — attached is a sample invoice PDF (sample_invoice_po-ref.pdf) that mirrors the XML we send to EDI/SFTP partners. Key confirmations:
- Invoice header fields we populate: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, PO_Number (exact PO string sent by Suncrest), BillToName, BillToAddress, RemitToID (appears in both header and machine-readable XML under <RemitToIdentifier>), Currency, TaxAmount, TaxBasis, LineItems.
- RemitToID will be visible in the PDF header and included as <RemitToIdentifier> in the XML export. For human review, we include the identifier right under the invoice number.
- Reverse-charge text: when Suncrest has a valid VAT number we will include the statement "VAT reverse charge - customer to account for VAT under Article 194" and print the customer VAT ID on the invoice. If you need a slightly different wording for local tax teams we can update the template — just tell us the preferred phrase.

Quick note on currencies / entity choice: please register Redwood Inference EU Ltd if you plan to receive EUR invoices from us; otherwise register Redwood Inference, Inc. for USD. That ensures the invoice legal entity and bank details align and avoids payment rejections.

I've also shared a Drive link to the onboarding packet in case you need the full signed packet: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Onboarding/Suncrest-AP-Packet

Mateo Alvarez
Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
